correctness.rationale: Direct integration establishes exact two-point Monod means. The ratio log derivative has sign W2/W1-H(v), where H is strictly increasing in variance. Endpoint signs give threshold m^2>K1*K2 for exactly one internal ratio maximum. Comparing a2/a1 with the lower endpoint and maximum proves precisely two strict growth-rank reversals. The rational example has two exact simple roots within 0<v<m^2; 10,906 exact-arithmetic diagnostics supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The exact if-and-only-if mean-concentration condition distinguishes monotone ranking under increasing variance from two genuine ranking reversals despite two strictly concave Monod functions and unchanged mean nutrient, common mortality and fixed maximum uptake constants. This is a reproducible boundary for comparing specialist/opportunist growth in deliberately imposed temporal nutrient environments; no claim about competition with resource feedback.
